title: Maintaining Journalistic Integrity in the Digital Age: A Comprehensive NLP Framework for Evaluating Online News Content

bias_targets.methodology: Using natural language processing (NLP) techniques such as sentiment analysis, opinion mining, topic modeling, and transformer-based contextual language models (e.g., BERT, RoBERTa) to detect subjective language, opinionated statements, framing, and subtle linguistic biases in news articles to evaluate their objectivity, balance, and fairness.
